text: Digestion turns food into absorbable molecules. Chewing and stomach acid begin mechanical and chemical breakdown. The small intestine does most of the work: enzymes split proteins, fats, and carbohydrates while villi absorb the results into blood. Gut microbes ferment leftover fiber and produce vitamins.
